description: This file appears to be a C header file defining structures and functions related to managing loose objects in a version control system, likely Git. It declares a structure for mapping loose objects and several functions for initializing, clearing, adding, reading, and writing these maps within a repository context.

methods.name: loose_object_map_clear
methods.description: Clears the contents of a loose_object_map structure.

methods.name: repo_loose_object_map_oid
methods.description: Maps a source object ID to a compatible object ID within the repository, using specified hash algorithms.

methods.name: repo_add_loose_object_map
methods.description: Adds a loose object mapping from an object ID to a compatible object ID for a given source.

methods.name: repo_read_loose_object_map
methods.description: Reads the loose object map for the specified repository.

methods.name: repo_write_loose_object_map
methods.description: Writes the loose object map for the specified repository.
